# Erdos.p859 — Erdős problem 859

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/859
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/859.lean`, theorem `erdos_859`, AMS 11).

The density of the divisor sum set is asymptotically equivalent to $c_1 / \log(t)^{c_2}$.

## Statement
∃ c₁ > 0, ∃ c₂ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ d : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ t > 0, (DivisorSumSet t).HasDensity (d t)) ∧
      (fun (t : ℕ) ↦ d t) ~[atTop] (fun t ↦ c₁ / Real.log t ^ c₂)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
